title: SignedEvidence
description: An EvidenceCertificate plus the m-of-n governance signatures over its canonical bytes. The signed bytes are `b"crucible-evidence-v1\u0000" + canonical_json(certificate)`, where `certificate` is exactly the object under `certificate` here (the serialized form, with empty additive members dropped). Reflects framework.v2.evidence.models.SignedEvidence.

certificate.description: The signed certificate. Its canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators) under the evidence domain tag is the exact byte string every signature covers.

signatures.description: Governance authoriser signatures. Verification counts DISTINCT valid authorisers present in the trust root and compares to the trust root's threshold (m-of-n).

Signature.description: One authoriser signature over a canonicalised document.

key_id.description: Stable authoriser id; must match a key_id in the trust root to count.
